hypothesis: Nɔ tswaa nɔ nyɛɔ nyɛmi ɔ, nɔ mlɔgbelɔ ji lɛ. Nɛ nyɛ lɛɛ kää nɔ mlɔgbelɔ koo, nɔ mlɔgbelɔ koo bɛ nɛɛ nɛ wami nɔ?

reference: Nimli kpekpemi ɔ a ti nɔ kake de Yesu ke, “Tsɔɔlɔ, de ye nyɛmi ɔ nɛ e kɛ mi nɛ dla gbosi ní ɔ.”
hypothesis: Nɛɛ kɛ pee mɛo, aatí noo kaa kɛ Deyɛɛ tsukɛ. Tshɔɔ lɔ? Deyɛɛ nyɛmí ɔ nɛ kɛ mɛnɛ dragbótsii nyɛ.

reference: Se mohu ɔ, nyɛ ha nɛ nyɛ je mi bami he nɛ tsɔ kaa bɔ nɛ nɔ nɛ tsɛ nyɛ ɔ ngɛ klɔuklɔu ɔ.
hypothesis: Se moɔ, nyɛha ne nyɛ jemi ba miɔhiɛ ne tsɔ, kɛ abonɛ ne tsɔ nyɔhiɛ krɔnkrɔn.

reference: “Benɛ wa ya a, tsu ɔ nya ngɛ ngangɛ. A ngmɛ mi kpɛii, nɛ buli ɔmɛ hu pee klaalo kɛ daa si ngɛ sinya a nya. Se benɛ wa bli ɔ, wa nɛ bɔfo ɔmɛ a ti nɔ ko nɔ ko!”
hypothesis: Be ne wa hiɔ, tsɔnya nganga, a ngme me pɛɛ, ne buliɔ me hu pɛɛ klaa lokɔdatsngɛsi nya nya. Se be ne wa bli ɔ, wa ne bɔ fɔɔ me a ti nɔkɔ nɔkɔ.

reference: Yesu he nɔ ke, “Nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ ɔ, amlɔ nɛ ɔ, o nui sisi; se pee se ɔ, o ma ba le.”
hypothesis: Yɛɛ su he nɔ kɔ, nɔ nɛ i ngɛ pee nɛ o, amlɔnɛ o, o nu i sisi, pee sii o, o ma ba le.

reference: Wa kpa laami mi zo ní tsumi; wa yi kutupɔ, nɛ Mawu munyu ɔ hu wa tsakee we hɛ mi. Wa fiɛɔ Mawu sɛ gbi ɔ paa ngɛ ma hɛ mi, nɛ wa bɔɔ mɔde kaa nihi nɛ a ná wa he juɛmi kpakpa ngɛ Mawu hɛ mi.
hypothesis: ɔpawa lɛ emi mzoni tsumi, wayi ku tupɔ, nɛ mɔmuko nyɔhu wa chakewe hɛmi, wa fyaɔ mɔse bwiɛngpange mahɛmi, nɛ wa bɔ mɔde kani nɛ anɔ wayi jwemi pampangɛ mɔuhɛmi

reference: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e sa nɛ e ba jã, konɛ nɔ́ nɛ a ngma ngɛ a mlaa a mi ke, ‘A nyɛ mi yaka gu’ ɔ nɛ ba mi.
hypothesis: Lɔ hiɔ, Isaniɛ bajan, kɛnɛnɔne anmgmamɛ mla mi kɛ, anyɛmi ya kagboɔne ba

reference: A he nɔ ke, “Saminya! Tse mo hu Galilea no ji mo! Yaa kpa ngmami ɔmɛ a mi kaa o maa na gbalɔ ko nɛ je Galilea lo!”
hypothesis: A heɛ nɔ kɛ sa mi nya, tsɛ mɔ Galileano ji mɔ. Anee Akpa mwa mɛɛ ami kaɔ mɔ nagba kɔne ji Galileano?

reference: Wa biɔ nyɛ hɛ mi nyɛɛli ɔmɛ, kɛ ni klɔuklɔu ɔmɛ tsuo. Ni nɛmɛ nɛ je Italia a hu ke a biɔ nyɛ.
Mumi ɔ nɛ Mawu haa nyɛ, kɛ nyakpɛ níhi nɛ e tsuɔ ha nyɛ ɔ, anɛ mlaa a nɔ nɛ nyɛ yeɔ ɔ he je, aloo sane kpakpa a nɛ nyɛ nuɔ nɛ nyɛ heɔ yeɔ ɔ?
hypothesis: Mue meme ma he nye, ke nya pe nene e tsu nye o, ane mla no ne nye yi o he je, aloo sande kpakpa ne nye nuo ne nye he o ye o?

reference: Niatsɛmɛ nɛ ngɛ nyɛ kpɛti ɔ, nyɛɛ a nɔ nɛ a ko wo a he nɔ. Á ko ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ ní nɛ a na a nɔ, ejakaa ní nami se maa po. Á ngɔ a hɛ ngɔ fɔ Mawu mohu nɔ. Lɛ nɛ e haa wɔ ní kpakpahi babauu nɛ wa yeɔ faa.
hypothesis: Nye a tsɛ me niŋɛ kɛkɛ ti oo, nye a no ne a ko wuo ahe no, a ko ngɔ ahe ngɔ fo ni ne a naa no, e ja kɛ ni na mi sɛ mampɔ, a ngɔ ahe ngɔ fo ma mbohu no, lɛne e ha wani kpakpa i baba wuni wa yi ɔ fa.

reference: Simon na kaa bɔfo ɔmɛ a nine nɛ a ngɔ pue nihi nɛ he ye ɔ a nɔ ɔ ha nɛ a na Mumi Klɔuklɔu ɔ. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, e je sika kɛ ha Petro kɛ Yohane,
hypothesis: ji mɔ ngɔ baboo maa ni ne ngɔ pue niine he yoɔ anɔ ane anɛ Mumi Kɔŋkɔli lɔɔ he ɔ e ji tsika kɛ ha Petro kɛ Yohane

reference: Kɛ ba lɛ kɛɛ nɛ a ha mi he blɔ nguaa nɛ ɔ, kaa ye Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ nyɛ ma ba slaa mi?
hypothesis: Kɛbaa lɛ kɛnɛɛ, aha mɛ blɔ ngɛ wano, kɛ anyɛ nyomtsɛmɛ ɔmɛ basla mɛ.

reference: Kristo he odase nɛ nyɛ ngɛ yee ɔ ba he si wawɛɛ nɛ nihi na.
hypothesis: Bi tɛɛ o daa te ni nyiɛ yeɔ ba hiɛ ni waa wɛne ni.

reference: Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo fo kɛ ya na Simon Petro, kɛ kaselɔ kpa a nɛ Yesu suɔ lɛ ɔ ngɛ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. E de mɛ ke, “A wo Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ gbogboe kɛ je yɔkɔ ɔ mi, nɛ wa li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya fɔ.”
hypothesis: Kɛkɛ nɛ e wo fo ya nɛ tsimɔ petee, kɛ kase lɔpɔɔ nɛ e susumɔ lɛ ngɔ ngɛ he nɛ a ngɛ ɔ. E de mɛ kɛ: A woniɔmtsɛ gbeje kɛ jeyɔkoɔ mi, nɛ wa li he nɛ a kɛ lɛ ya.

reference: Kɛkɛ ɔ, nyɛ maa ba nyɛ je mi bɔ nɛ maa sa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ hɛ mi. Nyɛ ma tsu ní kpakpa sɔuu, nɛ nyɛ maa le Mawu saminya pe bɔ nɛ nyɛ le lɛ daa.
Ke nyɛ pee nɔ́ nɛ i de nyɛ ke nyɛɛ pee ɔ, lɔ ɔ lɛɛ ye huɛmɛ ji nyɛ.
I ngɛ to kpa komɛ hulɔ, se mɛɛ a piɛ we kuu nɛ ɔ he. Ma ngɔ mɛ hu kɛ ba; a maa nu ye gbi, nɛ a maa pee to kuu kake, kɛ hyɛlɔ kake.
hypothesis: I ngɛ a tɔ koku kɛɛ hu lɔ, se me a pe e ku ne ɔ he. Mampɔ ngɛ me hu kɛ ba, ama ne ɔ yee gbe, ne a ma pe to kuka kɛ kɛ hiɛ lɔ kake.

reference: Asafoatsɛ ɔ na Aleksandria lɛ ko ngɛ hiɛ ɔ nɛ yaa Italia, nɛ e je wɔ ngɔ wo mi.
hypothesis: Osɔfɔɔ tsɔneɔ Alexandra lɛ kɔngɛ yiɔɔ nɛ ya Italia, nɛ eje wɔngɔwɔmi

reference: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, wa tsɔ Yuda, kɛ Sila, konɛ mɛ hu a ba jaje ní nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wa ngma a nɔuu ngɔ tsɔɔ nyɛ.
hypothesis: Lohiɔɔ, wa tsɔi udami, kɛ tsila, ko nɛ mɛhu aba jaje nɛɔ mɛni wa ngma

reference: Abraham to e tsui si, nɛ e nine su nɔ́ nɛ Mawu ke e ma ha lɛ ɔ nɔ.
Ma je li tete po a ke wa ko fiɛ ha mɛ, konɛ a ko he a yi wami. Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, yayami ɔ, pe a ngɛ pee kɛ ngɛ nɔ toe babauu daa ligbi. Se jehanɛ lɛɛ Mawu kɛ e mi mi fumi ɔ kple a nɔ!
Je ɔ sɛ́ nimli nɛ ɔmɛ! A wo lalaalo ngɛ nga kplanaa nɔ, kɛ yohi a nɔ. A hi tɛ puɔhi, kɛ muɔhi a mi.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yayami hu. Se nɔ nɛ ngɛ yayami pee kɛ mwɔɔ ɔ, e nɛ Kristo, nɛ e li lɛ hulɔ.
hypothesis: Loo hee ɔ, kee nɔ ko ngɛ Kristo mi ɔ, e pee we yee ya mi hu. Se nɔ ne ngɛ yee ya mi pee kɛ muɔ ɔ, ene Kristo nɛ e li le hu loo.

reference: Biɛ kpakpa nɛ a wo nyɛ ɔ, anɛ pi mɛ nɛ a gbeɔ he guɛ ɔ?
hypothesis: Nɛ kpa nɛ awo nyɔ, a nɛ pi mi nɛ a bi ɔ he guɛ o.

reference: Munyu nɛ e tu ɔ, anɛ pi wɔ tutuutu wa he nɛ e kɔɔ lo? Nihi nɛ gbaa ní, kɛ ni nɛmɛ nɛ kpaa ní ɔ, e sa kaa a tsu ní kɛ hɛ kɛ nɔ fɔmi kaa mɛ hu a maa ye niba ní ɔ eko.
Nikodemo, nɔ nɛ be ko e ya Yesu ngɔ nyɔ mi ɔ, lɛ hu e ngɔ tsopa kɛ e he via, nɛ ji mire kɛ aloe nɛ a futu, nɛ jiimi maa pee kilo nyingmi etɛ kɛ ba, nɛ e piɛ Yosef he kɛ ho.
Benɛ Paulo je e nya kikɛ nɛ ɔ, Festo de kɛ ngmlaa kɛ wo lɛ ke, “Paulo, o yi mi ngɛ puɛe pɛ! Womi kasemi sɔuu lɛ wo mo godo nɛ ɔ nɛ!”
hypothesis: Mẹne Paulo je enya kike no, feto de ke ngmlake wole ke, Paulo, oyi mi nga puo e pe, wo mi ka temi so 'n lao mogodone o.

reference: Se Petro he nɔ ke, “Awetsɛ, pi a ti nɔ kake ji mi!”
hypothesis: Jee Kpɛtsu he no kɛ? Aweetɛ, bi a tee no kɛ ke ji mɛni?

reference: Nɛ ke e hia kaa imi hu ma ya a, i kɛ mɛ maa ya.
hypothesis: Nɛ kɛɛ hia ka imɔ maya, i kɛmɛ maya. Maya gba maki dɔnya lokoo ma ba nyɛngɔ. Ejaakɛ itɔ yemi ka maya.

reference: Nyɛ hu nyɛɛ piɛ wa he kɛ kpa pɛɛ, konɛ nihi babauu nɛ na Mawu si ha wɔ kaa nihi babauu a pɛɛ kpami nya a, wa na dloomi nike níhi.
Kristo ngɛ loko a bɔ níhi tsuo, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ níhi tsuo ngɛ a hanɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
hypothesis: Kɛji tsɔmi ngɛ lɛɔ kɛ abɔni tsɔ, nɛ lɛ nɛ ha nɛ ni tsɔmi ngɛ aha nɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

reference: I ngɛ gbeye yee kaa nɔ́ nɛ ba Hawa nɔ be ko ɔ maa ba nyɛ hu nyɛ nɔ. Sinɔ ya sisi Hawa, nɛ Hawa pee yayami. Jã kɛ̃ lɛ a ma puɛ nyɛ tue, nɛ nyɛ be Kristo anɔkuale yee kɛ pi si hu.
hypothesis: Nene ba ye e ka, noobɛ hawa no bekpɔ m'abanye hunye no. Tino ya ti si hawa, ne hawa peeya yami. Jaa kɛle amaponyɛ twe, ne nyɛbe Klisto anokwale yee kɛpii.

reference: Yesu de ke, “I ngɛ nyɛ dee anɔkuale mi ke, ke to tsu ngɛ, nɛ nɔ ko ya kuɔ kɛ gu he kpa kɛ sɛ mi, se e gui to tsu ɔ nya a, jamɛatsɛ ɔ, julɔ kɛ ojo fialɔ ji lɛ.
Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ kikɛmɛ a munyu nɛ ɔmɛ nɛ wo nyɛ sibi a bua.
hypothesis: Lɔhe ɔ, niakaki kɛ mamuinyɛ nɔɔmɛ nɛɛ wɔnyɛ tsee abua.

reference: Lɔ ɔ he ɔ, ke wa ngɛ nya mi ngma, kɛ heha ní kɛkɛ ɔ, e hiɛ ha wɔ hluu.
hypothesis: Lɔɔ he ɔ, kɛ wa ngɛ nyɛmiɛmɔ, kɛ hɛhanii keke ɔ, ehe hia wɔ luu?

reference: Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ kojo we nɔ ko. E ngɔ jamɛ a he blɔ ɔ tsuo kɛ ha Bi ɔ, konɛ Bi ɔ nɛ kojo nihi.
hypothesis: Tjaɔ ni tsɛ Kɔjo we nɔ kɔ, e nɔ jamɛ he blo tsho ke ha biɔ, ko ne biɔ ne Kɔjo ni.

reference: E ngɛ mi kaa wa ngɛ he lo mi mohu, se kɛ̃ ɔ, wa pee we he lo nya ní.
Yihi enyɔ maa hi nɔ́ wɛɛe ngɛ he kake; a maa ngɔ nɔ kake kɛ je, nɛ a ma si nɔ kake ngɛ se.
hypothesis: Ene ji nyɔmihi wei ngɛ hi kake, a mangɔ nɔ kake kɛ ji, na amati nɔ kake ngɛ

reference: Ma mi he nɛ a je ɔ, a ngɛ he susue jinɛ a ko na he blɔ nɛ a kpale kɛ ho lejɛ ɔ ya.
hypothesis: Mami hene a gbe o, amɛ efi fi ejine akonahe blɔne akwale kɛ ho le gbee o.

reference: Benɛ Mawu ha nɛ e hi kɛ pi si ɔ, e ba pee nɔ nɛ haa nihi nɛ buɔ lɛ tue ɔ naa neneene yi wami hemi.
hypothesis: Bɛnɛ ma ho ha nɛ e hi Kpɛsi o, e ba pee nɔɔ nɛ ha ni nɛ buɔ lɛ tue o, na nɛ nɛ yi wa mi he.

reference: Nyɛ nitsɛmɛ nyɛ le sane ɔ nɛ ba ngɛ Yudea a tsuo momo; e je sisi kɛ je Galilea, kɛ je benɛ Yohane, nɔ sɔlelɔ ɔ fiɛ ɔ se.
Se wɔɔ lɛɛ Kristo nɛ a sɛu ɔ wa ngɛ fiɛe. Enɛ ɔ peeɔ blɔ tsimi nɔ ha Yuda bi, nɛ Hela bi hu buu lɛ kaa kuasiahi a sane.
hypothesis: Nɛ wɔ hlɛ kɛ tsɔ nɛ atsɛngwangɛ fiɛɛ, ɛnɛɔ pɛ oblochimino hayuda bi, nɛ helabi hu bulɛ kankwasiang asa nɛ.

reference: Benɛ wai yiblii nya buami be su ɔ, e tsɔ e nyɔguɛ apaa yeli ɔmɛ a ngɔ, konɛ e ya ngɔ e blɔ fa mi nɔ́ ɔ ngɛ a dɛ kɛ ba. Se apaa yeli ɔmɛ fia nyɔguɛ ɔ ní, nɛ a ha nɛ e kpale e se kɛ ho dɛ gu.
hypothesis: Beni wa ngɛ bli nya bua mi be suo, e tsɔ i nyɔngue apasa yelio ma ngɔ, kɛne e ya ngɔ e blɔfo mi nɔ ngɛ Adne Keba, se apasa yelio mi fia nyɔngue ɔ ni, ne a ha ni ekpale ese ke hu ke de gu.

reference: Benɛ e na Petro kɛ Yohane nɛ a yaa sɛ sɔlemi we ɔ, e ba mɛ ní.
Benɛ Saulo nyɛɛ blɔ ɔ nɔ kɛ yaa, nɛ e su Damasko haa a, tlukaa a, la ko kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba bɔle lɛ.
hypothesis: Beni Saulo nye blɔ ni kɛ ya ne e su Damasko hiɔ, truka, la ko kpɛ kɛ je hiɔwe kɛ ba bole lɛ

reference: Jehanɛ ɔ, be ɔ ma, nɛ Mawu ma ha nihi he wami, konɛ a ja Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ mumi mi kɛ anɔkuale mi kaa bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ nitsɛ suɔ. Pohu be ɔ su momo.

Nyɛ ngɛ nihi akpeakpe nɛ a ngɛ nyɛ nɔ hyɛe mohu, se nɛ nyɛ ba le Kristo ɔ, tsɛ kake pɛ lɛ nyɛ ngɛ. Ejakaa kɛ gu sane kpakpa a nɛ i ngɔ ba ha nyɛ ɔ nɔ ɔ, nyɛɛ kɛ Yesu Kristo ba bɔni bɔmi, nɛ i ba pee nyɛ tsɛ.
Anɛ i be ye dɛ he lo? Anɛ pi bɔfo ji mi lo? Anɛ i nɛ Yesu, wa Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ lo? Nɛ nyɛ nɛɛ? Ní nɛ i tsu ha Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ, anɛ pi nyɛ ji nɔ́ nɛ je mi kɛ ba lo?
Benɛ e na lɛ ɔ, e kɛ lɛ ba Antiokia ekohu. A kɛ asafo ɔ hi si jeha mluku, nɛ a tsɔɔ nihi babauu ní. Antiokia ji he nɛ a wo nihi nɛ he ye ɔ biɛ ngɛ ke Kristo we bi.
hypothesis: E kple ba Antiochia ikohuu, a kasefoi hi ji amlukuu. Naa tsoo ni babaoni, Antiochia hi ne a woni ne eji obienge Klistowe

reference: Se Saulo ya nɔ nɛ e fiɛ kɛ he wami pe kekle ɔ po kɛ tsɔɔ kaa Yesu ji Kristo ɔ nɛ. Enɛ ɔ ha Yuda bi nɛ ngɛ Yerusalem ɔ a nya mi jɔ.
Mawu ɔ, nɔ ko nɛ lɛ hyɛ. E bi kake too ɔ nɛ hii si ngɛ Tsɛ ɔ hiɔ nɔ ɔ, lɛ nɛ e tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ nɛ Tsɛ ɔ ngɛ ha.
hypothesis: Mawu nɔɔ nɔkene lɛ hie, e bi ka kɛ toɔ ne hiisime tsɔ hio no, lɛ ne e tsɔɔ wɔ bɔ ne tsɔɔ ngɛ ha.

reference: Petro hi Yopa be saii ngɛ lohwe he womi tsopa wolɔ ko nɛ a tsɛɛ lɛ Simon ngɔ.
A ha bɔfo ɔmɛ ba da a hɛ mi, nɛ a bi mɛ ke, “Kɛ nyɛ pee kɛɛ nɛ nyɛ tsa glɔtsɛ ɔ? Mɛnɔ he wami nya, aloo mɛnɔ biɛ mi nyɛ tsu nɔ́ nɛ ɔ?”
A maa ngɔ lɛ ngɔ wo ma je li a dɛ mi; ma je li ɔmɛ maa ye e he fɛu, nɛ a ma jɛ lɛ, nɛ a maa la lada ngɔ pue e nɔ.
i ngɛ womi nɛ ɔ ngmae kɛ ha mo Timoteo, ye bi nitsɛnitsɛ ngɛ hemi kɛ yemi ɔ mi.
hypothesis: I ngɛ nyinimewɔmɔ he kɛ ha mo, Timoteo, ye bi ni tsɛni tsɛngɛ he mi kɛ nyemimɔɔmɛ.

reference: Mawu lɛ je tsɔɔ mi kaa ma ya Yerusalem, nɛ i ya. I kɛ nihi nɛ a buu mɛ ɔ kɔklɔɔ ya kpe, nɛ sɛ gbi nɛ i ngɛ fiɛe ha ma je li ɔmɛ ɔ, i tsɔɔ mɛ nya, bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ní tsumi nɛ i tsu kɛ sɛ hlami, kɛ nɔ́ nɛ i ngɛ tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ pee yaka.
hypothesis: Nɛ lɛ ji tɔmi kaa ma ya Yerusalem, nɛ i ya. I kɛ nɛ abɔɔ me ngɔklɔ ya kpe, nɛ sɛgbene i ngɛ fyae ha ma jelɔ ɔ me, i tsɔ mɛ nya. Bɔ nɛ pee nɛ ni tsumi nɛ i tsu kɛ tɛla mi, kɛ nɔ nɛ i ngɛ tsue amlɔ nɛ ɔ koo pee ya kpe.

reference: Jinɛ e susu kaa e nyɛmimɛ ɔmɛ maa na kaa Mawu ngɛ e nɔ gue nɛ e kɛ kpɔ mɛ, se e ya bɛ mi ja.
hypothesis: jinɛ e susu kaa enyɛmi mɔmɔɔ mɔ nɔ kaa mɔ ngɛ enɔ gbee ne e kpɔ mi, se e ya be mi ji

reference: Benɛ tsɔli ɔmɛ kpale kɛ ba a, osɔfo nikɔtɔma amɛ, kɛ Farisi bi ɔmɛ bi mɛ ke, “Mɛni he je nyɛɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ ɔ?”
hypothesis: Be ne tso lɔɔ me palke ba, ɔtsɔpɔ ni kɔtɔ mɔ me, kɛ fali ti biɔ me bi me kɛ, mene je nyɛ kɛ lɛ bɛ.

reference: Nyɔmtsɛ ɔ ma je mi kɛ maa je ní yayamihi tsuo a mi, nɛ e kɛ mi maa ya hiɔwe he nɛ e ngɛ matsɛ yee ngɛ ɔ fiafiaafia. A maa wo e hɛ mi nyami kɛ maa ya neneene. Amen.
hypothesis: Nnɛɔ, ma jemi kɛ ma jeni yɛ yami hɔɔ ami, nɛ e kɛ mi ma ya hiiɔwe. Enɛ, ɛngamatsɛye ngɛɔ fia fia fia. Amawɔɔ, e himi nyami kɛ ma ya neneene. Amen.

reference: Jamɛ a be ɔ, nihi nɛ ngɛ Yudea a, a tu fo kɛ ya yo ɔmɛ a nɔ; nihi nɛ ngɛ ma a mi ɔ, a je, nɛ nihi nɛ ngɛ ngmɔ si ɔ, a ko ba ma a mi.

reference: Si kake too ɔ, hiɔwe bɔfohi a ta nguaa ba piɛ bɔfo ɔ he, nɛ a la kɛ je Mawu yi ke,
